content:
q30.

Memo lifecycle events and their webhook dispatch functions (all in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, methods on `APIV1Service`):

- memo created (`memos.memo.created`): `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (line 15) — invoked from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:156-158`
- memo updated (`memos.memo.updated`): `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (line 20) — invoked from `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:68`
- memo deleted (`memos.memo.deleted`): `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (line 25) — invoked from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:561-563`
- memo comment created (`memos.memo.comment.created`): `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (line 30) — invoked from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:120`

Delivery convergence: the created/updated/deleted dispatchers all funnel through the shared helper `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:48`), and every event — including comment-created — ultimately delivers via `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, which enqueues the payload for bounded asynchronous dispatch (the synchronous path being `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`).
